title: Git-bug: Distributed, offline-first bug tracker embedded in Git
summary: Git-bug is a distributed, offline-first bug tracker that stores bug reports and tracking data as Git commits, allowing teams to track issues without requiring a central server or internet connection.
problem_solved: Enables offline bug tracking and distributed issue management without relying on centralized services like GitHub Issues or Jira.
why_valuable: Developers can manage bugs entirely within their Git workflow, sync through normal Git operations, and work fully offline in any environment.
